title: The Legend of the First Diya (Diwali Special)
caption:
🪔 THE LEGEND OF THE FIRST DIYA (DIWALI SPECIAL) ✨

On the darkest night of Kartik Amavasya, ancient Ayodhya was wrapped in silence and shadow.
One lone child cupped his hands against the fierce wind... and lit the very first earthen lamp.
From that single sacred spark, a million golden diyas erupted across the Sarayu ghats to welcome Lord Rama home.

No darkness in this world can ever extinguish the light within you.
May the divine light of Diwali illuminate your path with courage, joy, health, and peace.
Wishing you and your loved ones a blessed, radiant, and Happy Diwali! 🎆✨🪔
